comment: Lines coverage per group (cargo llvm-cov, inline test modules and GTK glue excluded). A PR may not lower a group by more than tolerance_pp. Raise with build-aux/coverage.sh --update-baseline. Goal: every group at target; see docs/ci-gates.md. bookx-ui is the Broadway-suite number of build-aux/coverage-ui.sh (80.06% measured on 2026-11-21, 3810 checks passed, 12 failed), kept a point lower because timing varies.
